profile.org_note: Not a for-sale builder: a private, vertically integrated rental-housing developer with four operating companies (development, construction, property management, investment management) under founder-CEO Chris Finlay and a small partner group. Land is sourced centrally by Head of Land Acquisitions Reece Kimsey (5-person team) and locally by market Development Partners, who each lead sourcing, capitalization, entitlement and construction and roll up to a Regional Development Partner. Capital sits with the development capital markets and private capital heads (TJ Sedeski, Brooks Honeycutt) and partners Corey Gibson and Rachel Noone. The finance and capital bench turned over in 2026: the CIO, a CFO, the head of capital markets and the Southeast regional head have all dropped off the company site (see notes). TX, AZ and CO are new 2026 markets with staff but no announced projects yet. Main phone is the issuer phone on the firm's SEC Form D filings (1921 Gallows Road, Suite 700, Vienna, VA 22182); the site publishes only info@livemiddleburg.com.
profile.summary: NOT A CONVENTIONAL HOMEBUILDER and a weak fit for lot-option land banking. Middleburg is a private developer, builder and operator of rental housing (Mosby apartments, Hamlet single-family build-to-rent, Vesta workforce housing); its 4,150 Builder 100 'closings' are 2025 rental unit starts (NMHC No. 11 developer, No. 13 builder), not home sales. It has 52 projects and 18,000+ units under control, about 5,600 under construction, and plans 18 to 20 starts in 2026 across the Southeast and Mid-Atlantic plus a new Western platform (Dallas, Phoenix, Denver). It ties up sites under contract, entitles them with its own GP fund money and closes land with construction financing, so there is no finished-lot takedown stream; the only plausible angle for a land banker is pre-development land carry on BTR or apartment sites.
